I visited yesterday. The compassion shown by the staff was heart warming. The clear love for animals was evident in how they treated a poorly stray cat. A cat who had been living rough, probably never had a home or even a name. The vet held his paw as he drifted off for the final time. In what was a very emotional morning for me having recently had to say goodbye to my precious little doggy the vet showed that she really cares. The vet displayed patience and empathy, taking time to explain everything to me. The respect that she showed the kitty gives me a little bit of faith in humanity even in these tumultuous times. I have named the beautiful orange feline Roger. He will join the loved and unloved at the rainbow bridges. Peace and love to the team, I know that your job must be so tough sometimes.
